text:
alex: deploy-bot just quarantined canary for release candidate rc/2.3.1 — vuln scan showed a HIGH in openssl. can anyone grab this?
deploy-bot: [Automated] Vulnerability scan results for rc/2.3.1: 1 HIGH (openssl CVE-2026-0001), 2 MEDIUM. Action: canary QUARANTINED. See /ci/reports/rc-2.3.1/vuln.json
maria: on it. quick question — SBOM provenance mismatch flagged too, saw: base image digest != builder-record. kim can you confirm builder change? :eyes: 
kim: confirmed — infra moved builder image from alpine:3.15@sha256:aaa.. to 3.16@sha256:bbb.. last night, that brought in openssl variant. reproducing locally now.
alex: thanks. options as I see them: 1) pin base image to previous digest and rebuild (slower, ~2h), 2) hotpatch openssl dependency within the image (faster, ~1h, may be more risk), 3) rollback canary to previous release and block RC (longer). Thoughts?
ryan: we need to avoid blocking change window if possible — PM prefers minimal delay. If hotpatch is safe and QA signs off we can roll forward.
maria: agree but need legal/compliance signoff if we change SBOM provenance or ship with a known patched-but-unverified component. @legal any quick take?
legal: short: shipping with a patched dependency ok if we document it in release notes and capture a mitigation plan in the ticket. if provenance mismatch persists we need an exception documented.
sre-oncall: also watch for runtime regressions after hotpatch — please run canary smoke with heavy qps after deploy. we can auto-fallback via deploybot if latency > 200ms or error rate > 1%.
kim: local smoke looks fine after patching openssl -> libssl 1.1.1k -> 1.1.1l. test matrix: unit + integ pass, but need 30m canary.
deploy-bot: Suggested workflow: 1) apply hotpatch branch (hotfix/openssl-cve), 2) trigger canary deployment to 5% traffic, 3) run smoke + vuln-scan on canary image, 4) if green, promote and update SBOM + release notes, 5) create follow-up to pin base image in next stable build.
alex: I'm leaning hotpatch + promote if canary green. maria and kim take the patch. I'll draft release notes snippet.
maria: starting hotpatch now. pushing branch and CI.
kim: CI passed build. kicking canary deploy: `/deploy rc-2.3.1-hotfix --canary 5%`
deploy-bot: [Automated] Deploy started: rc-2.3.1-hotfix -> canary 5%. Watch: /deploy/logs/1739012345
kim: running vuln-scan on canary image now.
kim: vuln-scan result: HIGH fixed, SBOM provenance still flagged due to builder digest mismatch but vulnerability absent.
legal: still need exception doc for provenance mismatch. alex please add to release notes: "Builder provenance mismatch — exception filed, patch applied to mitigate CVE-2026-0001; follow-up pin planned."
alex: added to release notes draft and linked ticket INF-6423.
ryan: ok from PM, go ahead if canary smoke for 30m looks stable.
sre-oncall: monitoring. setting auto-fallback to previous stable for 60m window.
kim: 30m canary smoke green. latency stable, error rate 0.2%.
deploy-bot: Canary checks passed. Promotion scheduled in 10m unless veto.
maria: no veto from QA. promoting.
deploy-bot: Promotion complete. RC rc-2.3.1-hotfix -> prod-slice. Release notes updated: /docs/releases/rc-2.3.1.md#notes
alex: thanks team. follow-up: pin base image in next CI run and close INF-6423 after verification. :thumbsup:
